items.title: Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: When I’m sitting with Art Blakey and he’s talking about Charlie Parker and Sarah Vaughan... those were his friends

ctx.x: I think that’s really interesting in that sometimes when you see a new artist and you see the cast of supporting characters in it, like wow, I always thought that that probably came from the record company. Like you need to have this to help sell your first.

More times than not it does. More times than not it does. But for me, again, no disrespect to Ron, no disrespect to Les McCann, no disrespect to Kenny Barron or Freddie Hubbard, but I started with Art Blakey. If I’m sitting with Art Blakey and he’s talking about Charlie Parker and Sarah Vaughan, Thelonious Monk, John Coltrane, Miles Davis, those were his friends, Bud Powell, so that gave me the confidence because that was an American Express card. When I told people I was with Art Blakey I’d be right in. So I did…

impeccable with your word, and don’t assume. And I found that not taking anything personal, although it seems like it’s a hard concept, nothing is personal. If you got up right now and said I hate the way this interview is going and I hate the way this is working out, we’re done, you’re out of here. That’s not my issue. That’s something that you felt, that I can’t go inside of your mind to figure out. So it’s not personal. It was your choice. So it’s a hard concept, and it’s taken me years to really wrap myself…
